name: Riverstone Retreat Guest House
tagline: Tranquil Riverside Comfort and Local Warmth
description: Overlooking the pebble-lined banks of the clear Shanti River, Riverstone Retreat Guest House provides a calm, family-run escape from bustling city routines. Enjoy organic garden produce, home-cooked regional specialties, and bird-watching decks under canopy trees in an invented peaceful sanctuary.

rooms.name: Garden Cottage Room
rooms.description: Cozy ground-floor bedroom with veranda access facing landscaped herbal and flower gardens.

rooms.name: Riverside Family Room
rooms.description: Spacious family accommodation featuring wide windows facing the flowing river waters and shaded mango trees.

gallery.alt: Shaded stone courtyard with flowering bougainvillea
Wooden river deck overlooking pebble river bank
Open-air veranda where fresh breakfast is served

houseRules: Eco-sensitive zone: plastic disposal in designated bins only
Pet friendly with prior notice and confirmation
Strictly no loud amplified music on riverside decks after 09:30 PM

faqs.question: Is home-cooked dinner available at the guest house?
faqs.answer: Yes, delicious home-cooked regional thalis are prepared fresh daily upon advance notice before 04:00 PM.

faqs.question: Is the property pet friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes, well-trained pets are welcome in Garden Cottage rooms.

reviews.author: Debashish Mishra
reviews.text: The river view and absolute quietness are therapeutic. The hosts treated us like family, and the breakfast was outstanding.

reviews.author: Kavita Nair
reviews.text: Spotless rooms, fresh morning air, and birds chirping all day. Exactly what a relaxing countryside guesthouse should be.
